## JavaScript API

Pass up to 1,024 bytes of a JSON-serializable object to the webhook. This data will be included in the webhook payload.

## Command line

Pass up to 1,024 bytes of a JSON-serializable object to the webhook. This data will be included in the webhook payload. Alternatively, pass a file path pointing to a JSON file

## CLI flag

```text
--webhook-custom-data <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
